test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rohan alone can do a work in 10 days and Mohan alone can do the same work in 15 days. In how many days will they together complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

Rohan's time = 10 days, Mohan's time = 15 days

**Formula used:**

1/Rohan's time + 1/Mohan's time = 1/Total time

**Calculation:**

1/10 + 1/15 = 1/Total time

⇒ Total time = 30/(5)

⇒ 6 days

**Hence, they will complete the work together in 6 days.**
